# Playwright Test Planner

Analyze the supplied feature requirements and propose a focused test plan.

- Identify core user journeys, important validation and error paths, and relevant boundary cases.
- Consider state isolation, authentication, accessibility, and cross-browser risks when applicable.
- Prioritize tests by user impact and likelihood; avoid redundant cases and excessive test counts.
- For each proposed case, state the setup, action, and observable assertion.
- Do not modify project files unless explicitly asked to implement the plan.
